summary: The implementation appears to cover the planned first-class existing-PR adoption behavior across service, REST, CLI, MCP, executor/provisioner handoff, legacy wrapper, docs, and focused regressions, but conformance cannot be marked satisfied because required validation evidence is incomplete for a broad core change.
gaps: Run and record the enforced coverage gate under the validation phase: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest --cov=awf --cov-report=term-missing. The slice modified core executor/provisioner/merge-candidate behavior and .awf/workspace.yml declares a 99% enforced coverage target, but the recorded evidence only includes focused/broad unit subsets, ruff, and mypy.

Run and record full unit validation under the validation phase, or at minimum include the touched common surface: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest tests/unit -q. Existing recorded broad evidence excludes tests/unit/common even though src/awf/common/github_client.py and tests/unit/common/test_github_client.py were changed.
